Subject: Intermittent latency impacting checkout — service incident #INC-4271

Hi Connor,

We saw repeated ~800-1200ms tail latency spikes on tokenization calls that power Paywise checkout between 11/20 02:00 UTC and 11/21 05:30 UTC. This caused several checkout timeouts (visible in our logs) and an increase in failed payment attempts. Our SREs traced the issue to a degraded instance pool and the KV cache miss storm during a traffic spike; your status page (INC-4271) indicates mitigation but we still had client impact.

We need an official impact summary and a proposal for remediation/compensation to present to our CFO and procurement. For context: 
- Estimated incremental revenue at risk for the period: ~$95k
- November invoice (attached) is due 12/5

Please provide a written remedy proposal and any documentation (post-incident notes, root cause analysis). We are open to term adjustments tied to renewal.

Attachments: screenshot-checkout-errors.png (image), paywise-nov-invoice-1142.pdf

Thanks,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Partnerships, Paywise
olivia.barnes@paywise.com

1) One free month (Dec 2026) + one-time invoice credit of $25,000 — simple, fast to apply.
2) Two-month credit spread (Dec + Jan) totaling $40,000, contingent on signing an addendum that adjusts SLAs and schedules a joint postmortem.

My recommendation: option 1 to close quickly and preserve renewal momentum unless leadership wants to use a larger concession in exchange for a multi-year renewal. Requesting quick approval so I can respond to Olivia with an offer and a DocuSign path.
